stable_interface_contracts.invariant: Only deterministic Controller code owns authoritative execution transitions, authorization, budgets, verification, recovery truth, and completion.
ready/blocked are derived views and mutation dispatch is rechecked inside one current execution epoch.
Started attempts are immutable history; repair creates a new bounded attempt.
Dispatch requires current dependencies, evidence, baseline, checkpoint, permission possibility, and resource admission in one Controller epoch.
Compiler produces immutable candidate Plan IR revisions; PlanValidator and Controller activation remain deterministic authority.
No plan revision becomes active without deterministic Plan IR v1.2 structural, policy, evidence, and resource validation.
Filesystem/Git source is truth; retrieval indexes are fingerprinted, derived, and rebuildable.
Every model call receives a fresh bounded projection; persistent knowledge size never implies prompt size.
Provider details never enter Plan IR or Controller semantics; the M1 normal profile uses one physical local model at a time.
Tools expose declared structured effects and cannot self-authorize or lower deterministic risk.
Exact action authorization is durable, policy/epoch bound, and checked again before mutation.
Retained raw evidence means immutable post-ingress/redacted CAS bytes under explicit quotas.
Synopsis is bounded and derived, with expansion handles to retained evidence; expansion never reruns the tool.
Only fresh typed acceptance evidence can satisfy task or goal completion.
Checkpoints are monotonic hash/reference-verified snapshots over authoritative state and journal position.
Recovery replays authoritative events, reconciles unknown actions, and never blindly repeats uncertain side effects.
Heavy capability admission is lease based and preserves capability richness with runtime sparsity.
Memory is provenance/freshness governed evidence and never independent policy or repository truth.
Logical roles reuse the same physical model serially and cannot elevate permissions.
Skills are progressively loaded instructions/evidence and cannot grant authority.
Only SecretRef is durable/model-visible; resolved values are ephemeral action-only data and are redacted before persistence.
External intelligence is optional untrusted advisory evidence with explicit export policy and zero tool, approval, or completion authority.

forbidden_dependency_rules.subject: crates/sovereign-types
forbidden_dependency_rules.rationale: Foundation types are authority-neutral and cannot depend on product authority owners.

forbidden_dependency_rules.subject: crates/sovereign-state
forbidden_dependency_rules.rationale: Authoritative persistence is a lower layer and cannot depend on execution, planning, policy, model, tool, retrieval, context, evidence, or memory behavior.

forbidden_dependency_rules.subject: crates/sovereign-evidence
forbidden_dependency_rules.rationale: Evidence storage may depend on state/types but cannot depend on higher-level authority or execution subsystems.
